rules.title: React import
rules.rationale: Compose runtime provides state primitives; SwiftUI needs no React equivalent.

rules.title: react-native import
rules.rationale: Platform UI toolkit import.

rules.title: Design-token import
rules.rationale: Tokens live in the shared native design-system module.

rules.title: Sibling module import
rules.rationale: Same-feature components share a module/package natively.

rules.title: Props type alias
rules.rationale: TS types map to Swift/Kotlin types: string→String, number→Double, boolean→Bool/Boolean, T[]→[T]/List<T>, () => void→() -> Void/Unit.

rules.title: Function component
rules.rationale: Function components become SwiftUI views and composable functions.

rules.title: useState hook
rules.rationale: Local UI state; setter calls become assignments.

rules.title: Render return
rules.rationale: JSX root becomes the view body.

rules.title: Block close
rules.rationale: Structural close of component scope.

rules.title: View (column)
rules.rationale: RN default flexDirection is column.

rules.title: View (row)
rules.rationale: Row layouts map to horizontal stacks.

rules.title: ScrollView
rules.rationale: Vertical scroll container.

rules.title: Text
rules.rationale: JSX interpolation becomes native string interpolation.

rules.title: Pressable
rules.rationale: Tap targets; style applies to the button container.

rules.title: Switch
rules.rationale: Two-way binding to state.

rules.title: TextInput
rules.rationale: Controlled text input.

rules.title: ActivityIndicator
rules.rationale: Indeterminate spinner.

rules.title: Custom component call
rules.rationale: JSX props become labelled / named arguments.

rules.title: Box style props
rules.rn: padding, backgroundColor, borderRadius, width, height, gap, alignItems
rules.rationale: Compose modifier order: clip → background → clickable → padding.

rules.title: Text style props
rules.rationale: Typography spreads map to font tokens.

rules.title: useEffect hook
rules.rationale: Retrieved from migrated examples MIG-104, MIG-131. Empty deps = run on appear.

rules.title: FlatList
rules.rationale: Retrieved from migrated examples MIG-109, MIG-140. Lazy lists keyed by stable id.

rules.title: Remote Image
rules.rationale: Retrieved from MIG-112. Uses the platform async image loader.

rules.title: Conditional render (&&)
rules.rationale: Retrieved from MIG-118. Short-circuit JSX becomes an if-block.

rules.title: Number.toFixed
rules.rationale: Retrieved from MIG-121. Fixed-precision formatting.

rules.title: flex: 1
rules.rationale: Retrieved from MIG-126. Fill remaining space.

rules.title: justifyContent: space-between
rules.rationale: Retrieved from MIG-133.

rules.title: State seeded from prop
rules.rationale: Swift cannot reference self in a property initialiser; agent emits an explicit init.

rules.title: keyboardType
rules.rationale: Retrieved from MIG-137.

configs.name: Baseline · single-pass rules
configs.description: One pass over the file using core rules only. No retrieval, no token lookup, no verification.

configs.name: Rules + design-token retrieval
configs.description: Core rules plus lookup of every style value in the design-token registry.

configs.name: Agentic · pattern retrieval + tokens + self-check
configs.description: Plans the file, retrieves extended patterns from the reviewed migration library, resolves tokens, then self-checks output (brace balance, bindings, unmapped lines) and routes gaps to human review.
